title.narrative: Strengthening health systems and scaling-up of integrated community case management interventions - Burkina Faso (01-Oct-2015-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Burkina Faso, RSSH, Programme d'Appui au Développement Sanitaire (PADS) (PADS)This program has the following goals: Contribute to the highest attainable standard of health for the entire population through an effective national health system. The objectives of this program are: Develop human resources for health care (health workers and CHWs). Ensure that quality health information is available at all levels, including the community level. Improve health system and community-based service delivery. Strengthen health sector governance. Strengthen the national system for the procurement, distribution and management of health products at all levels. Strengthen the quality assurance of health products and laboratory tests, and pharmacovigilance
